mapper.sql: id, task_no, publisher_id, assignee_id, task_type, title, description, pickup_addr, deliver_addr, pickup_lat, pickup_lng, deliver_lat, deliver_lng, is_paid, price, status, expect_time, deadline, assign_time, finish_time, confirm_time, cancel_reason, refund_reason, refund_status, pay_order_id, pay_out_trade_no, pay_status, images, finish_images, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, tenant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO twelve_runner_task (task_no, publisher_id, task_type, title, description, pickup_addr, deliver_addr, pickup_lat, pickup_lng, deliver_lat, deliver_lng, is_paid, price, status, expect_time, deadline, images, create_by, create_time, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{publisherId}, #{taskType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{pickupAddr}, #{deliverAddr}, #{pickupLat}, #{pickupLng}, #{deliverLat}, #{deliverLng}, #{isPaid}, #{price}, #{status}, #{expectTime}, #{deadline}, #{images}, #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW(), #{tenantId})

where.if: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR task_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM twelve_runner_task
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalTasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('accepted','running','pending_confirm') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_paid = 1 AND status = 'completed' THEN price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalGmv FROM twelve_runner_task
tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT FROM twelve_runner_task WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND is_paid = 1 AND pay_status = 'paid' AND pay_out_trade_no IS NOT NULL LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM twelve_runner_task WHERE pay_out_trade_no = #{payOutTradeNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE twelve_runner_task SET pay_status = #{payStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND pay_status = 'unpaid' AND status != 'cancelled'
UPDATE twelve_runner_task SET pay_status = 'refunded', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND pay_status = 'paid'
